en.t: Athanasius is elected Patriarch of Alexandria
en.s: The Patriarch of Alexandria is the archbishop of Alexandria, Egypt. Historically, this office has included the designation "pope" (etymologically "Father", like "Abbot"). The Alexandrian episcopate was revered as one of the three major episcopal sees (along with Rome and Antioch) before Constantinople and Jerusalem were granted similar status (in 381 and 451, respectively).

zh.t: 亚他那修当选亚历山大宗主教
zh.s: 亚历山大宗主教是埃及亚历山大的大主教。历史上，这一职位也包括“教宗”这一称号，其词源意为“父亲”，与“修道院院长”一词相同。在君士坦丁堡和耶路撒冷于 381 年和 451 年获得类似地位之前，亚历山大教区与罗马、安提阿并列为三个主要主教座之一。

en.s: The Battle of Gerberoy was fought in 1435 between French and English forces. The French were led by La Hire and Jean Poton de Xaintrailles, who were victorious. The English losses were heavy, which later included their commander, John FitzAlan, 14th Earl of Arundel.

zh.s: 1435年，法国军队与英军在热尔伯鲁瓦交战。法国军队由拉伊尔和让·波东·德·桑特拉耶指挥并获胜。英军损失惨重，后来还包括其指挥官、阿伦德尔伯爵约翰·菲茨艾伦。

en.s: Abdal-Latif Mirza (c. 1420 – 9 May 1450) was the great-grandson of Central Asian emperor Timur. He was the third son of Ulugh Beg, Timurid ruler of Transoxiana (modern Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and parts of Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan) and Roqya Katun Arolat.

zh.t: 帖木儿王朝君主阿卜杜勒·拉蒂夫遭刺杀
zh.s: 阿卜杜勒·拉蒂夫·米尔扎（约1420年至1450年5月9日）是中亚统治者帖木儿的曾孙。他是乌鲁伯格与罗克娅·卡通·阿罗拉特的第三个儿子；乌鲁伯格是帖木儿王朝河中地区的统治者，统治范围包括今乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和哈萨克斯坦的部分地区。

en.s: The Battle of Auldearn was an engagement of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It took place on 9 May 1645, in and around the village of Auldearn in Nairnshire. It resulted in a victory for the royalists led by Montrose and Alasdair MacColla over a Covenanter army under the command of Sir John Urry (or Hurry). The pibroch Blár Allt Earrann commemorates the battle. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and is protected by Historic Scotland under the Historic Environment (Amendment) Act 2011.

zh.s: 奥尔迪恩战役是三王国战争期间的一场战斗，于1645年5月9日在奈恩郡奥尔迪恩村及周边地区发生。蒙特罗斯和阿拉斯代尔·麦科拉率领的王党军击败了约翰·厄里爵士（也作赫里）指挥的圣约派军队。风笛曲《布拉尔特埃兰》纪念这场战役。战场已列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并依据2011年《历史环境修正法》受到苏格兰历史遗产部门保护。

en.s: The Battle of Simbach on May 9, 1743, took place during the War of Austrian Succession near Simbach am Inn. It ended with a heavy defeat of the Bavarian troops against the Austrians.

zh.s: 1743年5月9日，奥地利王位继承战争期间，辛巴赫战役在因河畔辛巴赫附近爆发。巴伐利亚军队惨败于奥地利军队。

en.s: The Skirmish of Loch Ailort was a conflict that took place on 9 May 1746 at Loch Ailort, in the district of Moidart, Scottish Highlands and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745. On 9 May 1746, almost a month after the Jacobite defeat at the Battle of Culloden, a skirmish took place at Loch Ailort, Moidart between a group of Jacobites from the Clan Macdonald of Clanranald who were led by their chief, the Young Ranald MacDonald, against a British-Hanoverian Government force.

zh.t: 洛赫艾洛特湖小规模冲突
zh.s: 1746年5月9日，苏格兰高地莫伊达特地区的洛赫艾洛特湖发生小规模冲突，是1745年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。库洛登战役中詹姆斯党战败近一个月后，克兰拉纳德氏族的詹姆斯党人由年轻的拉纳德·麦克唐纳率领，与英汉诺威政府军交战。

en.s: The Exhibition of 1761 was the inaugural art exhibition staged by the Society of Artists of Great Britain (SAGB), a group of painters, architects and sculptors. The exhibition opened on 9 May 1761 and was held at Spring Gardens in Westminster, London.

zh.s: 1761年艺术家协会展览是英国艺术家协会首次举办的艺术展。该协会由画家、建筑师和雕塑家组成。展览于1761年5月9日在伦敦威斯敏斯特的斯普林花园开幕。

en.s: The siege of Fort Detroit was an ultimately unsuccessful attempt by North American Natives to capture Fort Detroit during Pontiac's War. The siege was led primarily by Pontiac, an Ottawa chief and military leader. This rebellion would be one of the catalysts that hastened the declaration of the Proclamation of 1763 which would eventually precipitate the events leading to the American Revolution.

zh.s: 底特律堡围城战是北美原住民在庞蒂亚克战争期间试图攻占底特律堡的一次行动，最终未能成功。围城主要由渥太华族酋长兼军事领袖庞蒂亚克指挥。这场起义是促使英国颁布1763年《皇家公告》的因素之一；该公告后来也推动了美国革命的发生。

en.s: The Corsican War of Independence, also known as the Forty Years' War (Corsican: Guerra di 40 anni), was a conflict between Corsican nationalists and the Republic of Genoa, and later the Kingdom of France in its final phase. Initially a tax resistance movement, it quickly turned into a war of independence. Indirectly, this war accelerated the fall of the Republic of Genoa and also triggered an ethnic conflict between Corsicans and pro-Genoese Paomian Greeks.

zh.s: 科西嘉独立战争又称“四十年战争”（科西嘉语：Guerra di 40 anni），是科西嘉民族主义者与热那亚共和国之间的冲突，最后阶段则与法兰西王国交战。战争最初是一场反税收运动，很快演变为独立战争。这场战争间接加速了热那亚共和国的覆亡，也引发了科西嘉人与亲热那亚的帕奥米亚希腊人之间的族群冲突。

en.s: The Battle at the Yadkin River was a battle of the Regulator Movement fought at the crossing of the Yadkin River on May 9, 1771.

zh.s: 1771年5月9日，监管者运动期间，交战双方在亚德金河渡口附近发生战斗，史称亚德金河战役。

en.s: The Battle of Jutphaas, also known as the Battle of the Vaart or the Battle of Vreeswijk, occurred on 9 May 1787 on the banks of the Vaartsche Rijn canal near Jutphaas and Vreeswijk between Orangists and Patriots.

zh.s: 1787年5月9日，奥兰治派和爱国者派在尤特法斯与弗雷斯韦克附近的瓦尔茨河运河沿岸交战。这场战斗也称瓦尔特战役或弗雷斯韦克战役。

en.s: The Battle of Raismes, also known as the Battle of Condé or St. Amand, (8 May 1793) saw the French Republican army led by Auguste Marie Henri Picot de Dampierre attack the Allied Coalition army of Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The French intended to raise the Siege of Condé, but were defeated by Coalition forces. The battle was fought during the Flanders Campaign in the War of the First Coalition.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1793年5月8日，奥古斯特·玛丽·亨利·皮科·德·丹皮埃尔率领的法国共和军进攻萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德亲王约西亚斯指挥的联军，爆发赖斯梅战役，也称孔代战役或圣阿芒战役。法军希望解除孔代围城，但被联军击败。战斗发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间的佛兰德战役中。

en.s: The Battle of Fombio was fought between the French Army of Italy led by Napoleon Bonaparte and the Austrian army under Feldzeugmeister Johann Peter Beaulieu between 7 and 9 May 1796. It was the decisive strategic point of the campaign, as Bonaparte crossed the Po River at Piacenza in Beaulieu's rear, threatening both Milan and the Austrian line of communications.

zh.s: 1796年5月7日至9日，拿破仑·波拿巴率领的法意军团与约翰·彼得·博利厄元帅指挥的奥地利军队在伦巴第的丰比奥交战。这场战役是该战役行动的关键转折点：波拿巴的军队在皮亚琴察渡过波河，来到博利厄后方，威胁米兰和奥军交通线。

en.s: The Battle of Biberach on 9 May 1800 saw a French First Republic corps under Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr engage part of a Habsburg Austrian army led by Pál Kray. After an engagement in which the Austrians suffered twice as many casualties as the French, Kray withdrew to the east. The combat occurred during the War of the Second Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. Biberach an der Riss is located 35 kilometres (22 mi) southwest of Ulm. In late April 1800, a French army under the command of Jean Victor Marie Moreau crossed the Rhine river near Basel.

zh.s: 1800年5月9日，法兰西第一共和国军团在洛朗·古维翁-圣西尔率领下与帕尔·克赖指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军队交战。奥军伤亡是法军的两倍，克赖随后向东撤退。这场战斗发生在第二次反法同盟战争期间，该战争是法国大革命战争的一部分。比伯拉赫-安-德-里斯位于乌尔姆西南35公里（22英里）。1800年4月下旬，若望-维克托-马里·莫罗率领的法军在巴塞尔附近渡过莱茵河。

en.s: The Battle of Chegem was a significant engagement during the Kabardian Uprising of 1804, part of the broader Russo-Caucasian War. It took place on May 9, 1804, between the forces of the Russian Empire and a coalition of Kabardians, Karachay-Balkars from Chegem, and Ossetians. The battle was part of an anti-colonial rebellion aimed at resisting Russian expansion into Kabardia and the construction of Kislovodsk fortress.

zh.s: 1804年5月9日，切格姆战役在卡巴尔达起义期间爆发，是俄高加索战争的一部分。俄罗斯帝国军队与卡巴尔达人、切格姆卡拉恰伊人和奥塞梯人组成的联盟交战。这场战役属于反殖民起义，起义旨在抵抗俄罗斯向卡巴尔达扩张及其修建基斯洛沃茨克要塞。

en.s: The raid on Reghaïa in May 1837, during the French conquest of Algeria, pitted the French forces in Reghaïa region against the Kabyle troops of the Igawawen confederacy.

en.t: Battle of Resaca de la Palma
en.s: At the Battle of Resaca de la Palma, one of the early engagements of the Mexican-American War,United States General Zachary Taylor engaged the retreating forces of the Mexican Ejército del Norte ("Army of the North") under General Mariano Arista on May 9, 1846. United States troops were victorious and forced the Mexicans out of Texas.

zh.t: 雷萨卡德拉帕尔马战役
zh.s: 1846年5月9日，在美墨战争初期的雷萨卡德拉帕尔马战役中，美国将军扎卡里·泰勒率军迎战正在撤退的墨西哥北方军，由马里亚诺·阿里斯塔将军指挥。美军获胜，迫使墨西哥军队撤出得克萨斯。

en.s: The Texas Campaign was the first front in the Mexican–American War, fought between the United States and Mexico. The front started with a Mexican assault near Brownsville. US forces were forced to surrender after hours of resisting, which led President James K. Polk to declare war on Mexico. After the United States defeated a larger Mexican Army at Palo Alto and Resaca de la Palma, Mexican Forces led by Mariano Arista retreated out of Texas.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 得克萨斯战役是美墨战争的第一个战场，交战双方为美国和墨西哥。战事始于墨西哥军队在布朗斯维尔附近发动进攻。美军抵抗数小时后被迫投降，促使美国总统詹姆斯·K·波尔克向墨西哥宣战。美军随后在帕洛阿尔托和雷萨卡德拉帕尔马战胜人数更多的墨西哥军队；马里亚诺·阿里斯塔率领的墨军撤出得克萨斯。

en.s: The Greater Poland uprising of 1848 or Poznań Uprising (Polish: powstanie wielkopolskie 1848 roku / powstanie poznańskie) was an unsuccessful military insurrection of Poles against forces of the Kingdom of Prussia during the Revolutions of 1848. The main fighting in the Prussian Partition of Poland was concentrated in the Greater Poland region but some fighting also occurred in Pomerelia. Protests were also held in Polish-inhabited regions of Silesia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1848年大波兰起义，又称波兹南起义，是1848年革命期间波兰人反抗普鲁士王国军队的一场军事起义，最终失败。战斗主要发生在普鲁士统治下的波兰分区大波兰地区，波美拉尼亚也发生过一些战斗。波兰人聚居的西里西亚地区也举行了抗议活动。

en.s: The Second Battle of Dragoon Springs was one of two skirmishes involving Apache warriors and Confederate soldiers in Arizona. It was fought during the American Civil War on May 9, 1862 and was a response to the First Battle of Dragoon Springs in which Confederate forces were defeated. Four men were killed in the first skirmish and several heads of livestock were captured. The rebel commander Captain Sherod Hunter, ordered his foraging squad to take back the livestock from Cochise's warriors, during which five Apaches were killed. Confederate casualties were zero.

zh.s: 龙泉泉第二次战斗是亚利桑那地区阿帕奇武士与邦联士兵之间两次小规模冲突之一，于1862年5月9日美国内战期间发生。这场冲突是对第一次龙泉泉战斗的回应；此前邦联军在第一次战斗中落败，四人阵亡，数头牲畜被俘。叛军指挥官谢罗德·亨特上尉命令一支征粮队从科奇斯部族武士手中夺回牲畜，行动中五名阿帕奇人被杀，邦联军无人伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Swift Creek or Arrowfield Church was fought on May 9, 1864, between Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War. Union forces were only partially successful: they inflicted damage on the local railroad, but further advance was halted.

zh.s: 1864年5月9日，美国内战期间，联邦军与邦联军在弗吉尼亚州交战，史称斯威夫特溪战役，也称箭田教堂战役。联邦军只取得部分成果：他们破坏了当地铁路，但未能继续推进。

en.s: The Battle of Cloyd's Mountain occurred in Pulaski County, Virginia, on May 9, 1864, during the American Civil War. The fight has also been called the Battle of Cloyd's Farm. A Union Army division led by Brigadier General George Crook defeated a Confederate Army consisting of three regiments, one battalion, and Confederate Home Guard. The Confederate force was led by Brigadier General Albert G.

zh.s: 克洛伊德山战役于 1864 年 5 月 9 日在美国弗吉尼亚州普拉斯基县爆发，是美国内战的一场战役，也称克洛伊德农场战役。乔治·克鲁克准将率领的联邦军一个师击败了由三个团、一个营和邦联地方卫队组成的邦联军。邦联部队由阿尔伯特·G·詹金斯准将和约翰·麦考斯兰上校率领。

en.s: The Battle of Heligoland (or Helgoland) was fought on 9 May 1864, during the Second Schleswig War, between a Danish squadron led by Commodore Edouard Suenson and a joint Austro-Prussian squadron commanded by the Austrian Commodore Wilhelm von Tegetthoff. The action came about as a result of the Danish blockade of German ports in the North Sea; the Austrians had sent two steam frigates, SMS Schwarzenberg and Radetzky, to reinforce the small Prussian Navy to help break the blockade.

zh.s: 1864年5月9日，第二次石勒苏益格战争期间，爱德华·苏恩森准将率领的丹麦舰队与奥地利海军准将威廉·冯·特格特霍夫指挥的奥普联合舰队在赫尔戈兰岛附近交战。战斗起因是丹麦封锁北海的德国港口。奥军派出“施瓦岑贝格”号和“拉德茨基”号两艘蒸汽护卫舰，协助实力较弱的普鲁士海军打破封锁。

en.t: Der Krach: The Vienna stock exchange crash begins the Panic of 1873 and heralds the Long Depression
en.s: The Panic of 1873 was a financial crisis that triggered an economic depression in Europe and North America that lasted from 1873 to 1877, continuing until 1879 in the French Third Republic and in the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. In Britain, the panic started two decades of economic stagnation known as the "Long Depression" that weakened the country's economic leadership.

zh.t: 维也纳股市崩盘，1873年经济恐慌由此开始
zh.s: 1873年经济恐慌是一场金融危机，引发了欧洲和北美的经济萧条。萧条在欧洲和北美持续至1877年，在法兰西第三共和国和大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国则延续至1879年。在英国，这场恐慌引发了长达二十年的经济停滞，史称“长期萧条”，并削弱了英国的经济领导地位。

en.t: Australia opens its first national parliament in Melbourne
en.s: The Parliament of Australia (officially the Parliament of the Commonwealth and also known as the Federal Parliament) is the federal legislature of Australia. It consists of three elements: the monarch of Australia (represented by the governor-general), the Senate (the upper house), and the House of Representatives (the lower house).

zh.t: 澳大利亚在墨尔本召开首届联邦议会
zh.s: 澳大利亚议会（正式名称为联邦议会，也称联邦议会）是澳大利亚的联邦立法机构，由三个部分组成：澳大利亚君主（由总督代表）、上议院参议院和下议院众议院。

en.s: The 1908 Dundee by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 9 May 1908 for the constituency of Dundee. The constituency returned two Members of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1908年5月9日，英国下议院邓迪选区举行议会补选。该选区选出两名下议院议员，采用简单多数制。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Oklahoma City was held on May 9, 1911. Whit M. Grant was elected with 41% of the vote. He was sworn in on June 8, 1911. Candidates included attorney and businessman Whit M. Grant, businessman J. F. Warren, and socialist author and organizer Oscar Ameringer.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马城于1911年5月9日举行市长选举。惠特·M·格兰特以41%的选票当选，并于1911年6月8日宣誓就职。候选人包括律师兼商人格兰特、商人J·F·沃伦，以及社会主义作家和组织者奥斯卡·阿默林格。

en.s: The Battle of Arras took place on May 9, 1915, during World War One. The so-called Bayonne Legion (a French Foreign Legion infantry unit which consisted of ethnic Polish volunteers) clashed with troops of the Imperial German Army, defending the hill of Vimy, located 10 kilometers north of Arras, France. In August 1914, after the outbreak of the Great War, several ethnic Poles living in France volunteered to join French Foreign Legion, hoping that a separate, Polish unit would be created within that formation. On August 21, 1914, French authorities agreed to the request of Committee of Polish Volunteers, and soon afterwards, two Polish units were formed.

zh.s: 阿拉斯战役于1915年5月9日、第一次世界大战期间打响。由波兰裔志愿者组成的法国外国军团步兵部队“巴约讷军团”与守卫维米山的德意志帝国军交战。维米山位于法国阿拉斯以北10公里。1914年8月大战爆发后，多名居住在法国的波兰裔人士加入法国外国军团，希望军团能组建一支独立的波兰部队。1914年8月21日，法国当局同意了波兰志愿者委员会的请求，随后组建了两支波兰部队。

en.s: The Battle of Aubers (Battle of Aubers Ridge) was a British offensive on the Western Front on 9 May 1915 during the First World War. The battle was part of the British contribution to the Second Battle of Artois, a Franco-British offensive intended to exploit the German diversion of troops to the Eastern Front.

zh.s: 奥贝尔战役又称奥贝尔山脊战役，是英国军队于1915年5月9日在第一次世界大战西线发动的一次攻势。该战役是英国参与阿图瓦第二次战役的一部分；英法联军希望借此利用德军将部队调往东线的机会。

en.s: The Second Battle of Artois (French: Deuxième bataille de l'Artois, German: Lorettoschlacht) from 9 May to 18 June 1915, took place on the Western Front during the First World War. A German-held salient from Reims to Amiens had been formed in 1914 which menaced communications between Paris and the unoccupied parts of northern France. A reciprocal French advance eastwards in Artois could cut the rail lines supplying the German armies between Arras and Reims.

zh.s: 阿图瓦第二次战役于1915年5月9日至6月18日在第一次世界大战西线展开。1914年，德军控制的突出部从兰斯延伸至亚眠，威胁巴黎与法国北部未被占领地区之间的交通。法军若向东推进至阿图瓦，便可切断阿拉斯与兰斯之间德军的铁路补给线。

en.s: The Nivelle offensive (16 April – 9 May 1917) was a Franco-British operation on the Western Front in the First World War that led to mutinies in the French Army. The offensive was named after General Robert Nivelle, the commander-in-chief of the French metropolitan armies. The French part of the offensive was intended to be decisive by breaking through the German defences on the Aisne front within 48 hours, with casualties expected to be around 10,000 men.

en.s: The Battle of the Crna Bend was a significant military engagement fought between the forces of the Central Powers and the Entente in May 1917. It was part of the Allied Spring Offensive of the same year that was designed to break the stalemate on the Macedonian Front.

zh.s: 1926年法国杯决赛是法国顶级淘汰赛的决赛，于1926年5月9日在科隆布奥林匹克体育场举行。马赛奥林匹克以4比1击败瓦朗蒂涅体育协会，朱尔·德瓦克兹梅开二度，道格拉斯·德吕伊姆贝克和让·博耶也有进球。

en.s: Old Parliament House, formerly known as the Provisional Parliament House, was the seat of the Parliament of Australia from 1927 to 1988. The building began operation on 9 May 1927 after Parliament's relocation from Melbourne to the new capital, Canberra. In 1988, the Commonwealth Parliament transferred to the new Parliament House on Capital Hill.

zh.s: 旧澳大利亚国会大厦原名临时国会大厦，1927年至1988年间是澳大利亚议会所在地。议会从墨尔本迁往新首都堪培拉后，旧国会大厦于1927年5月9日开始启用。1988年，联邦议会迁入国会山上的新国会大厦。

en.s: The 1931 Tasmanian state election was held on 9 May 1931 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. For the first time, voting was compulsory, resulting in a high voter turnout.

en.s: The 1937 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 9, 1937, that saw FC Sochaux-Montbéliard defeat RC Strasbourg 2–1 thanks to goals by Miguel Angel Lauri and Bernard Williams.

zh.s: 1937年法国杯决赛于1937年5月9日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦奥林匹克体育场举行。索肖-蒙贝利亚尔足球俱乐部以2比1击败斯特拉斯堡竞赛俱乐部，米格尔·安赫尔·劳里和伯纳德·威廉姆斯为索肖进球。

en.s: Operation Bowery was an Anglo-American operation during the Second World War to deliver fighter aircraft to Malta, an operation known informally as a Club Run. Spitfires were needed to replace the remaining obsolete Hurricane fighters, to defend Malta from Axis air raids. In the first half of 1942, the Luftwaffe and Regia Aeronautica had inflicted serious damage on airfields, docks and other infrastructure.

en.s: The Take-Ichi sendan (Japanese: 竹一船団; lit. 'Bamboo Number One convoy') was a Japanese naval convoy of World War II. The convoy left occupied Shanghai on 17 April 1944, carrying two infantry divisions to reinforce Japan's defensive positions in the Philippines and western New Guinea. United States Navy (USN) submarines attacked the convoy on 26 April and 6 May, sinking four transports and killing more than 4,000 soldiers.

en.s: The landing at Bornholm was a Soviet military operation to capture and liberate the Danish island of Bornholm after it was heavily bombarded by the Soviet Air Force in May 1945 during the closing days of World War II. The German garrison commander, German Navy Captain Gerhard von Kamptz (1902–1998), refused to surrender to the Soviets, as his orders were to surrender to the Western Allies.

en.s: The Prague uprising (Czech: Pražské povstání) was a partially successful attempt by the Czech resistance movement to liberate the city of Prague from German occupation in May 1945, during the end of World War II. The preceding six years of occupation had fuelled anti-German sentiment and the rapid advance of Allied forces from the Red Army and the United States Army offered the resistance a chance of success.

en.s: Victor Emmanuel III (Italian: Vittorio Emanuele Ferdinando Maria Gennaro di Savoia; 11 November 1869 – 28 December 1947) was King of Italy from 29 July 1900 until his abdication on 9 May 1946. A member of the House of Savoy, he also reigned as Emperor of Ethiopia from 1936 to 1941 and King of the Albanians from 1939 to 1943, following the Italian invasions of Ethiopia and Albania.

zh.t: 意大利国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世退位，由翁贝托二世继位

en.s: The 1948 Bulgarian Cup final was the 8th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Lokomotiv Sofia and Slavia-Chengelov on 9 May 1948 at Yunak Stadium in Sofia. Lokomotiv won the final 1–0.

en.s: The Ninth-of-May (1948) Constitution (Czech: Ústava Československé republiky; Slovak: Ústava Československej republiky) was the second permanent constitution of Czechoslovakia, in force from 1948 to 1960. It came into force on 9 May, shortly after the communist seizure of power in the country on 25 February 1948. It replaced the 1920 Constitution. Work on the new document had been underway since the summer of 1946.
en.n: Czechoslovakia's Ninth-of-May Constitution comes into effect.

zh.s: 《五月九日宪法》（捷克语：Ústava Československé republiky；斯洛伐克语：Ústava Československej republiky）是捷克斯洛伐克第二部永久宪法，于1948年5月9日生效。此前，1948年2月25日共产党夺取政权。新宪法取代1920年宪法，起草工作自1946年夏季开始。
zh.n: 捷克斯洛伐克《五月九日宪法》于这一天生效。

en.s: The Schuman Declaration, or Schuman Plan, was a proposal to place French and West German production of coal and steel under a single authority that later became the European Coal and Steel Community, made by the French foreign minister, Robert Schuman, on 9 May 1950 (now celebrated in the EU as Europe Day), the day after the fifth anniversary of the end of World War II in Europe.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Mauritania on 9 May 1965. Following the merger of all the country's political parties into the Mauritanian People's Party (PPM), the country had become a one-party state in December 1961. As such, the PPM was the only party to contest the election, and won all 40 seats in the National Assembly. Voter turnout was 92.8%.

en.s: The election was held on 9 May 1968, with a third of the council up for vote, alongside three double vacancies in Broomhill, Handsworth and Mosborough. Overall turnout was 33.9%, a continuation of the preceding year's improvement. Following on from the previous year's momentous wins by the Conservatives, this historic night seen them surpass those and win control of the council for the first time since 1932, when it won as the Conservative-Liberal combination Progressives party. This election and the previous followed the national trend of Labour suffering massive losses around the country, even in their heartlands, with only two cities left Labour-controlled after these elections - Hull and Stoke - and even there the Tories were making significant inroads.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于1968年5月9日举行，三分之一的席位改选，布鲁姆希尔、汉兹沃思和莫斯伯勒三个选区另有各两个空缺。整体投票率为33.9%，延续了前一年投票率上升的趋势。保守党前一年取得重大胜利后，这次再创纪录，首次自1932年以来控制议会；1932年该党曾与自由党组成进步党执政。此次选举和上一年的选举都反映了全国趋势：工党在各地遭受重大损失，连传统票仓也不例外。选后伦敦以外只剩赫尔和斯托克两座城市仍由工党控制，保守党在这两地也明显扩大了影响。

en.t: 1968 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on 9 May 1968. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 14.3%. Until 1978, each London council had aldermen, in the ratio of one aldermen to six councillors. Tower Hamlets had ten aldermen. Following the elections, Tower Hamlets elected five aldermen, who served until 1974. The remaining five aldermen had been elected in 1964 and would serve until 1971.

zh.t: 1968年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔村伦敦自治市议会选举于1968年5月9日举行，全部议席改选，投票率为14.3%。1978年之前，伦敦各自治市议会设有市议员团，市议员与市议员团成员的比例为六比一。塔村有10名市议员团成员。选举后，塔村选出5人，任期至1974年；其余5人于1964年当选，任期至1971年。

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held in May 1968. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 20.7%. There were 23 wards. This election had aldermen as well as councillors. Labour got all ten aldermen as well as 33 directly elected councillors.

en.s: The 1971 WFA Cup Final was the first final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Southampton and Stewarton Thistle contested the match at Crystal Palace National Sports Centre in London on 9 May 1971. Southampton won the match 4–1. There was some controversy surrounding the match however.

zh.s: 1971年女子足球协会杯决赛是该项赛事的首届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛决赛。比赛由女子足球协会主办，于1971年5月9日在伦敦水晶宫国家体育中心举行，由南安普敦对阵斯图尔顿蓟花。南安普敦以4比1获胜，但比赛过程引起了一些争议。

en.s: Operation Pocket Money was the title of a U.S. Navy Task Force 77 aerial mining campaign conducted against the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) from 9 May 1972 (Vietnamese time), during the Vietnam War. Its purpose was to halt or slow the transportation of supplies and materials for the Nguyen Hue Offensive (known in the West as the Easter Offensive), an invasion of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), by forces of the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN), that had been launched on 30 March. Pocket Money was the first use of naval mines against North Vietnam.

zh.s: “零用钱行动”是美国海军第77特遣舰队对越南民主共和国（北越）实施的空中布雷行动，于1972年5月9日（越南时间）开始，属于越南战争的一部分。行动旨在阻止或减缓物资运输，以应对越南人民军于3月30日发动的“阮惠攻势”（西方称“复活节攻势”）；该攻势是越南人民军对越南共和国（南越）发动的入侵。“零用钱行动”是美国首次对北越使用水雷。

en.s: Battle of Kaukaba was a skirmish that took place on May 9, 1978 when PLO soldiers attacked Norwegian peacekeepers. en.s: Habib (Habibollah) Elghanian (Persian: حبیب (حبیب‌الله) القانیان; 5 April 1912 – 9 May 1979) was a prominent Iranian Jewish businessman and philanthropist who served as the president of the Tehran Jewish Society and acted as the symbolic head of the Iranian Jewish community in the 1970s.

en.s: The Sunshine Skyway Bridge, officially referred to as the Bob Graham Sunshine Skyway Bridge, is a pair of long beam bridges with a central tall cable-stayed bridge. It spans Lower Tampa Bay to connect Pinellas County (St. Petersburg, Florida) to Manatee County (Terra Ceia, Florida). The current Sunshine Skyway opened in 1987 and is the second bridge of that name on the site.

en.s: The 1981 Scottish Cup Final was played on 9 May 1981 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 96th Scottish Cup. Rangers and Dundee United contested the match. The first match, saw Dundee United start strongly, but fail to score. Rangers had the chance to win the match when they won a penalty at the end of normal time, but Ian Redford's effort was saved by Hamish McAlpine.

zh.s: 1981年苏格兰杯决赛于1981年5月9日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第96届苏格兰杯决赛。参赛球队是流浪者和邓迪联。首场比赛中，邓迪联开局积极，但未能进球。常规时间结束前，流浪者获得点球，有机会取胜，但伊恩·雷德福的射门被哈米什·麦卡尔平扑出。

en.s: General elections were held in Nepal on 9 May 1981 to elect members of the Rastriya Panchayat. 80% of the seats were elected through adult universal suffrage; this was the first election through universal suffrage held in Nepal in 22 years. However, political parties were banned at the time, and the main underground opposition forces (the Nepali Congress and various communist groups) called for a boycott of the election.

zh.s: 1981年5月9日，尼泊尔举行大选，选出国家评议会成员。80%的席位由成年公民普选产生，这是尼泊尔22年来首次举行普选。但当时政党仍被禁止，主要地下反对派——尼泊尔大会党和多个共产主义团体——呼吁抵制选举。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guinea on 9 May 1982. Incumbent Ahmed Sékou Touré was the only candidate (as the country as a one-party state with his Democratic Party of Guinea as the sole legal party at the time), and was re-elected unopposed. Voter turnout was reported to be 98.8%.

zh.s: 1982年5月9日，几内亚举行总统选举。时任总统艾哈迈德·塞古·杜尔是唯一候选人；当时该国实行一党制，几内亚民主党是唯一合法政党。杜尔未经对手挑战再次当选，投票率据报为98.8%。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta on 9 May 1987. Although the Nationalist Party received the most votes, the Malta Labour Party won a majority of seats. However, in accordance with the modifications made to the electoral system following a similar outcome in the 1981 elections, the Nationalist Party was awarded an extra four seats in order to give them a parliamentary majority.

zh.s: 1987年5月9日，马耳他举行大选。国民党获得最多选票，但马耳他工党赢得的席位过半。由于1981年选举出现类似结果后选举制度有所调整，国民党额外获得四个席位，取得议会多数。

en.s: LOT Polish Airlines Flight 5055 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Warsaw to New York City. In the late-morning hours of 9 May 1987, the Ilyushin Il-62 operating the flight crashed in the Kabaty Woods nature reserve on the outskirts of Warsaw around 54 minutes after departure. All 183 passengers and crew on board were killed in the crash, making it the deadliest accident involving an Ilyushin Il-62, and the deadliest aviation disaster in Polish history.

zh.s: 波兰航空5055号班机原定从华沙飞往纽约，是一条定期国际客运航线。1987年5月9日上午，执飞该航班的伊尔-62客机起飞约54分钟后，在华沙郊外的卡巴蒂森林自然保护区坠毁。机上183名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。这是伊尔-62型客机涉及的死亡人数最多的事故，也是波兰史上最严重的航空灾难。

en.s: Parliament House is the meeting place of the Parliament of Australia, located in Canberra, the capital of Australia. The building was designed by Mitchell/Giurgola & Thorp Architects and opened on 9 May 1988 by Elizabeth II, Queen of Australia. It cost more than A$1.1 billion to build. Federal Parliament meetings were first held in Melbourne until 1927.

zh.s: 澳大利亚国会大厦位于澳大利亚首都堪培拉，是澳大利亚议会的所在地。建筑由米切尔/焦尔戈拉与索普建筑事务所设计，1988年5月9日由澳大利亚女王伊丽莎白二世主持开放，建造费用超过11亿澳元。联邦议会此前一直在墨尔本开会，直到1927年迁往堪培拉。

en.s: The 1988 North Sumatra gubernatorial election was an indirect election held on 9 May 1988 to elect the Governor of North Sumatra for the 1988–1993 term. All members of the Regional People's Representative Council of North Sumatra were eligible to vote for this election. Incumbent governor Kaharuddin Nasution was named as a possible candidate, however, he did not contest in the election.

zh.s: 1988年5月9日，北苏门答腊举行间接选举，选出1988至1993年任期的省长。所有北苏门答腊地方人民代表议会成员都有资格投票。时任省长卡哈鲁丁·纳苏蒂安曾被列为可能候选人，但他没有参选。

en.t: 1989 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: A spill of the leadership of the Liberal Party of Australia took place on 9 May 1989, following internal maneuverings by supporters of John Howard's long-time rival, Andrew Peacock. The spill was won by Peacock over Howard by 44 votes to 27.

zh.t: 1989年澳大利亚自由党党魁改选
zh.s: 1989年5月9日，澳大利亚自由党举行党魁改选。约翰·霍华德的长期对手安德鲁·皮科克的支持者在党内运作后，改选随之举行。皮科克以44票对27票击败霍华德，当选党魁。

en.s: The 1990 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Sampdoria of Italy and Anderlecht of Belgium. It was the final match of the 1989–90 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 30th European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at Ullevi in Gothenburg, Sweden, on 9 May 1990. Sampdoria won the match 2–0, thanks to two goals in extra time from Gianluca Vialli.

zh.s: 1990年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由意大利桑普多利亚对阵比利时安德莱赫特，是1989—90赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事第30届决赛。比赛于1990年5月9日在瑞典哥德堡的乌莱维球场举行。桑普多利亚以2比0获胜，詹卢卡·维亚利在加时赛中连进两球。

en.s: The 44th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 9–20, 1991. The Palme d'Or went to the Barton Fink by Ethan and Joel Coen. The festival opened with Homicide, directed by David Mamet and closed with Thelma & Louise, directed by Ridley Scott.

zh.s: 第44届戛纳电影节于1991年5月9日至20日举行。伊桑和乔尔·科恩执导的《巴顿·芬克》获得金棕榈奖。大卫·马梅特执导的《凶杀》为开幕影片，雷德利·斯科特执导的《末路狂花》为闭幕影片。

en.s: The 1992 Scottish Cup final was played between Rangers and Airdrieonians, at Hampden Park, Glasgow, on 9 May 1992. Rangers won the match 2–1. They opened the scoring with a goal by Mark Hateley in the 30th minute, a finish from six yards after a low cross from the left. Ally McCoist made it 2–0 with a half-volley, before Andy Smith scored a consolation goal from outside the box.

zh.s: 1992年5月9日，流浪者在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场对阵艾尔德里人，进行苏格兰杯决赛。流浪者以2比1获胜。马克·哈特利在第30分钟打入首球，他接到左路低平传中，在距球门约6码处射门得分。随后阿利·麦考伊斯特凌空抽射，将比分扩大为2比0；安迪·史密斯在禁区外打入一球，为艾尔德里人扳回一分。

en.s: The 1992 FA Cup final was contested by Liverpool and Sunderland at Wembley. Liverpool won 2–0, with goals from Michael Thomas and Ian Rush.

zh.s: 1992年英格兰足总杯决赛由利物浦对阵桑德兰，在温布利球场举行。利物浦以2比0获胜，进球者是迈克尔·托马斯和伊恩·拉什。

en.s: The siege of Srebrenica (Serbo-Croatian: Opsada Srebrenice, Опсада Сребреницe) was a three-year siege of the town of Srebrenica in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina which lasted from April 1992 to July 1995 during the Bosnian War. Initially assaulted by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and the Serbian Volunteer Guard (SDG), the town was encircled by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) in May 1992, starting a brutal siege which was to last for the majority of the Bosnian War.

zh.s: 斯雷布雷尼察围城战是波黑战争期间对波黑东部城镇斯雷布雷尼察实施的一场围城，持续三年，从1992年4月到1995年7月。起初，南斯拉夫人民军和塞尔维亚志愿卫队对该镇发动进攻；1992年5月，塞族共和国军队包围了该镇，开始了一场持续波黑战争大部分时间的残酷围城。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Shusha (Codenamed: Operation Wedding in The Mountains; Armenian: Հարսանիք լեռներում, Harsaniq lernerum; Russian: Свадьба в горах, Svadba v gorakh) (Armenian: Շուշի, Shushi) was the first significant military victory by Armenian forces during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. The battle took place in the strategically important mountain town of Shusha on the evening of 8 May 1992, and fighting swiftly concluded the next day after Armenian forces captured it and drove out the defending Azerbaijanis.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 舒沙战役又称“山中婚礼行动”（亚美尼亚语：Հարսանիք լեռներում；俄语：Свадьба в горах），是第一次纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争中亚美尼亚军队首次取得的重要军事胜利。战斗于1992年5月8日晚在战略要地舒沙山城打响。亚美尼亚军队攻占该城并击退守城的阿塞拜疆军队后，战斗于次日迅速结束。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Stepanakert started in late 1991, during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War, in Stepanakert, the largest city in Nagorno-Karabakh, when the Azerbaijani forces circled the city. Until May 1992, the city and its Armenian population were the target of a months-long campaign of bombardment by Azerbaijan. The bombardment of Stepanakert and adjacent Armenian towns and villages, which took place under the conditions of total blockade by Azerbaijan, caused widespread destruction and many civilian deaths.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争期间，阿塞拜疆军队于1991年末包围了纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫最大城市斯捷潘纳克特，围城由此开始。直到1992年5月，该市及其亚美尼亚居民一直遭到阿塞拜疆军队持续数月的炮击。在阿塞拜疆全面封锁的情况下，斯捷潘纳克特及周边亚美尼亚城镇和村庄遭到炮击，造成大面积破坏和许多平民死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in Paraguay on 9 May 1993. In the country's first honest election, as well as the first with no military candidates since 1928, Juan Carlos Wasmosy of the Colorado Party won the presidential election, whilst the Colorado Party won a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, but the opposition Authentic Radical Liberal Party and National Encounter Party held a majority of the seats in both, later supplemented by the Colorado Reconciliation Movement which broke away from the Colorado Party. Voter turnout was 69.0% in the presidential election, 67.6% in the Chamber elections and 69.4% in the Senate elections.

zh.s: 1993年5月9日，巴拉圭举行大选。这是该国首次举行被认为公正的选举，也是1928年以来首次没有军人候选人参选。红党候选人胡安·卡洛斯·瓦斯莫西赢得总统选举；红党还在众议院和参议院赢得相对多数，但反对党真正激进自由党和国家相遇党在两个议院都占多数，后来又有脱离红党的红党和解运动加入。总统选举投票率为69.0%，众议院选举为67.6%，参议院选举为69.4%。

en.s: The 1995 Jacksonville mayoral election took place on May 9, 1995, following a primary election on April 11, 1995. The election was the first one to take place following the passage of a referendum in 1992 that provided for unitary elections, in which all candidates appeared on the same ballot regardless of party.

zh.s: 1995年5月9日，杰克逊维尔举行市长选举；此前曾于4月11日举行初选。这是1992年公投通过全体候选人同列一张选票的制度后，首次举行此类选举，不论党派，所有候选人都列在同一张选票上。

en.s: The 49th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 9–20, 1996. The Palme d'Or went to the Secrets & Lies by Mike Leigh. The festival opened with Ridicule, directed by Patrice Leconte and closed with Flirting with Disaster, directed by David O. Russell.

zh.s: 第49届戛纳电影节于1996年5月9日至20日举行。迈克·李执导的《秘密与谎言》获得金棕榈奖。帕特里斯·勒孔特执导的《荒谬无稽》为开幕影片，大卫·O·拉塞尔执导的《与灾难调情》为闭幕影片。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Uganda for the first time on 9 May 1996. The result was a victory for incumbent Yoweri Museveni, who won 75.5% of the vote. All candidates were independents, as political parties were banned at the time. Voter turnout was 72.3%.

zh.s: 1996年5月9日，乌干达首次举行总统选举。时任总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼以75.5%的选票获胜。当时政党被禁，所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。投票率为72.3%。

en.t: 1996 Brighton and Hove Borough Council election
en.s: The 1996 Brighton and Hove Borough Council election was held on 9 May 1996 to elect members to the new unitary authority of Brighton and Hove Borough Council in East Sussex, England. It was the inaugural election to the new council, and was held nearly a year before the council formally came into being on 1 April 1997, replacing the former Brighton Borough Council and Hove Borough Council.

zh.t: 1996年布赖顿和霍夫自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1996年5月9日，东萨塞克斯郡举行布赖顿和霍夫自治市议会选举，选出新设的单一层级地方政府议会成员。这是新议会的首次选举，比其正式成立晚近一年。新议会于1997年4月1日成立，取代原布赖顿自治市议会和霍夫自治市议会。

en.s: The Mother's Day bus crash occurred on May 9, 1999, on Interstate 610 (I-610) in New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, when a charter bus carrying 43 passengers veered off the roadway and collided with a dirt embankment. Of the 44 people on the bus (including the driver), there were 22 fatalities in the crash. The National Transportation Safety Board determined that the driver experienced a medical incapacitation resulting from severe, undiagnosed heart and kidney conditions.

zh.s: 1999年5月9日，一辆载有43名乘客的包车在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良的610号州际公路上驶离路面，撞上土堤。包括司机在内，车上44人中有22人死亡。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，司机因严重且未确诊的心脏和肾脏疾病突发身体失能，导致事故。

en.s: The 1999 Slamboree was the seventh Slamboree professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on May 9, 1999 from the TWA Dome in St. Louis, Missouri. This was the last WCW PPV to be promoted with the classic logo. Ten matches were contested at the event, including one dark match.

zh.s: 1999年Slamboree是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）举办的第七届Slamboree职业摔角付费赛事，于1999年5月9日在美国密苏里州圣路易斯的TWA巨蛋举行。这是WCW最后一场使用经典标志宣传的付费赛事。赛事共进行了10场比赛，其中包括一场未播出的垫场赛。

en.s: The 2000 Nebraska Democratic presidential primary took place on May 9, 2000, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Nebraska primary was a semi-closed primary and awarded 32 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 26 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary, and was one of two contests on that date.

zh.t: 2000年内布拉斯加州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年5月9日，内布拉斯加州举行民主党总统初选，是民主党2000年总统候选人提名初选的一部分。该州采用半封闭式初选，共分配32名代表参加2000年民主党全国代表大会，其中26名是根据初选结果分配的承诺代表。这是当天举行的两场初选之一。

en.s: The 2000 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary took place on May 9, 2000 alongside the Nebraska primary, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The West Virginia primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 42 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of whom 30 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary results.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年5月9日，西弗吉尼亚州与内布拉斯加州同日举行民主党总统初选，是民主党2000年总统候选人提名初选的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州采用半封闭式初选，向2000年民主党全国代表大会分配42名代表，其中30名承诺代表根据初选结果分配。

en.s: The 2000 West Virginia Republican presidential primary was held on May 9, 2000, as part of the 2000 presidential primaries for the 2000 presidential election. 18 delegates to the 2000 Republican National Convention were allocated to the presidential candidates, the contest was held alongside primaries in Nebraska. Texas Governor George W. Bush won the contest, taking all delegates with 80% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年5月9日，西弗吉尼亚州举行共和党总统初选，是2000年总统候选人提名初选的一部分。该州向共和党候选人分配18名全国代表大会代表，初选与内布拉斯加州的初选同日举行。得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什以80%的选票获胜，拿下全部代表席位。

en.s: The Accra Sport Stadium disaster occurred at the Ohene Djan Stadium, Accra, Ghana on May 9, 2001. It took the lives of 127 people, making it the worst stadium disaster to have ever taken place in Africa. It occurred during a match between Ghana's two most successful football teams, Accra Hearts of Oak Sporting Club and Asante Kotoko. Trouble had been anticipated, and extra security measures had been taken. The home side scored two late goals to defeat Kotoko 2–1 which led to disappointed Kotoko fans throwing plastic seats and bottles onto the pitch.

zh.s: 2001年5月9日，加纳阿克拉奥黑内·詹体育场发生踩踏惨案，造成127人死亡，是非洲史上死亡人数最多的体育场惨案。事发时，加纳两支最成功的足球队阿克拉橡树之心和库马西阿散蒂科托科正在比赛。此前已有骚乱预警，现场也加强了安保。主队最后时刻连进两球，以2比1击败科托科，失望的科托科球迷随后向球场内投掷塑料座椅和瓶子。

en.s: The 54th Cannes Film Festival took place from 9 to 20 May 2001. Norwegian actress and director Liv Ullmann served as the Jury President of the main competition; she replaced American actress and filmmaker Jodie Foster, who had to step down due to scheduling conflicts with the film Panic Room. Italian filmmaker Nanni Moretti won the Palme d'Or for the drama film The Son's Room.

zh.s: 第54届戛纳电影节于2001年5月9日至20日举行。挪威演员兼导演丽芙·乌曼担任主竞赛单元评审团主席，接替因档期冲突、必须退出的美国演员兼电影制作人朱迪·福斯特。意大利导演南尼·莫莱蒂凭剧情片《儿子的房间》获得金棕榈奖。

en.s: The 2002 Belgian Cup final, took place on 9 May 2002 between Club Brugge and Mouscron. It was the 47th Belgian Cup final and was won by Club Brugge.

zh.s: 2002年5月9日，布鲁日俱乐部与穆斯克龙队进行比利时杯决赛。这是第47届比利时杯决赛，布鲁日俱乐部获胜。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (2003) was a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) which took place on May 9, 2003 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 2003 International Gran Prix was the seventh time CMLL has held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.s: 2003年CMLL国际大奖赛是由墨西哥职业摔角联盟世界摔角理事会（CMLL）组织和编排的自由式摔角赛事，于2003年5月9日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，该场馆是CMLL的主场。自1994年以来，CMLL共举办过七届国际大奖赛，本届是第七届。

en.s: The 2005 Hit convoy ambush was an ambush by Iraqi insurgents of a convoy that was carrying military supplies for U.S. forces. The convoy was escorted by private military contractors. The ambush ended with the death of all the contractors.

zh.s: 2005年希特车队伏击事件中，伊拉克叛乱分子袭击了一支为美军运送军事物资的车队。车队由私人军事承包商护送，伏击导致所有承包商死亡。

en.s: The 2006 election for Mayor of Newark took place in Newark, the most populous city in the state of New Jersey, on May 9, 2006. Newark is organized under the Faulkner Act. Elections for all seats on the nine member Municipal Council of Newark were held the same day. A runoff election, if necessary, would have taken place.

zh.s: 2006年5月9日，美国新泽西州人口最多的城市纽瓦克举行市长选举。纽瓦克依据《福克纳法》组织地方政府，市政委员会九个席位也在同日改选。如有需要，将举行第二轮投票。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in East Timor in 2007. The first round on 9 April 2007 saw six of the eight candidates eliminated. The remaining two candidates, incumbent Prime Minister José Ramos-Horta and FRETILIN President Francisco Guterres, faced each other in a runoff election on 9 May 2007. Ramos-Horta won the second round with 69% of the vote.

zh.s: 2007年东帝汶举行总统选举。4月9日举行的首轮投票淘汰了八名候选人中的六人，留下时任总理若泽·拉莫斯-奥尔塔与东帝汶独立革命阵线主席弗朗西斯科·古特雷斯于5月9日参加第二轮投票。拉莫斯-奥尔塔在第二轮获得69%的选票并获胜。

en.s: The 2009 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 9, 2009, to elect the Mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. The election saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Mike Moncrief. The mayoral term in Fort Worth is two years. If no candidate received a majority of the vote in the general election, a runoff would have been held.

zh.s: 2009年5月9日，得克萨斯州沃思堡举行市长选举，与其他地方选举同时举行。选举不分党派，时任市长迈克·蒙克里夫成功连任。沃思堡市长任期为两年；若无人在普选中获得多数选票，则举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2009 FA Trophy Final was the 39th final of The Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. It was contested by Stevenage Borough, who won the competition in 2007, and York City on 9 May 2009 at Wembley Stadium in London. Stevenage won the match 2–0 to win the competition for the second time in their history.

zh.s: 2009年英格兰足总挑战杯决赛是英格兰足球联赛第五至第八级别球队参加的足总杯赛第39届决赛。比赛于2009年5月9日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛队伍是2007年夺冠的斯蒂夫尼奇自治市队和约克城。斯蒂夫尼奇以2比0获胜，第二次夺得该赛事冠军。

en.s: The 2009 Coupe de France final was the 91st final of France's most prestigious cup competition, the Coupe de France. The final was played at the Stade de France in the Paris suburb of Saint-Denis on 9 May 2009 and was contested between Rennes of Ligue 1 and Guingamp of Ligue 2. Guingamp earned its first Coupe de France trophy after defeating Rennes 2–1 through two second-half goals from Eduardo.

zh.s: 2009年法国杯决赛是法国最重要的杯赛第91届决赛，于2009年5月9日在巴黎近郊圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。参赛队伍是法甲球队雷恩和法乙球队甘冈。甘冈凭借爱德华多在下半场攻入的两球，以2比1获胜，队史首次捧起法国杯。

en.s: The San Antonio mayoral election of 2009 was held on May 9, 2009. The incumbent mayor Phil Hardberger was term-limited after serving two terms. The election was won by Julian Castro, who took office on June 1, 2009. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 2009年5月9日，圣安东尼奥举行市长选举。时任市长菲尔·哈德伯格因已连任两届而受任期限制。朱利安·卡斯特罗赢得选举，并于2009年6月1日就职。选举不分党派。

en.s: The 2009 Austin mayoral election was held on May 9, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Will Wynn was term-limited. No candidate received a majority of the vote, which would have precipitated a runoff election, but second-place finisher Brewster McCracken withdrew from the race making Lee Leffingwell the winner by default.

zh.s: 2009年5月9日，奥斯汀举行市长选举。时任市长威尔·韦恩因任期限制不能参选。没有候选人获得多数选票，本应举行第二轮投票，但排名第二的布鲁斯特·麦克拉肯退出竞选，李·莱芬威尔因此自动胜出。

loc: 德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州

en.s: The North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 2010, was an election held on May 9, 2010, to elect members to the Landtag (state legislature) of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia. The incumbent government at the election was the Christian Democrat (CDU)–FDP administration of Minister-President Jürgen Rüttgers. The biggest opposition party was the Social Democratic Party, led by Hannelore Kraft since 2005. As the election was held in Germany's most populous state, it was seen as a test of the federal government's performance after seven months in office. The federal government, also a CDU-FDP coalition, was accused of being indecisive as the two coalition partners had different aims.

zh.t: 2010年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 2010年5月9日，德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州举行州选举，选出州议会议员。时任州政府由基督教民主联盟（CDU）和自由民主党（FDP）组成，由州长于尔根·吕特格斯领导。主要反对党社会民主党由自2005年起担任党魁的汉内洛蕾·克拉夫特领导。由于该州是德国人口最多的州，此次选举被视为对联邦政府执政七个月表现的一次检验。联邦政府也由基民盟与自民党组成，外界批评两党目标不同、政府犹豫不决。

en.t: Dynamite Duumvirate Tag Team Title Tournament (2010)
en.s: Dynamite Duumvirate Tag Team Title Tournament (2010) was the fourth Dynamite Duumvirate Tag Team Title Tournament (DDT4) produced by Pro Wrestling Guerrilla (PWG). The event took place on May 9, 2010 at the American Legion Post #308 in Reseda, California. The PWG World Tag Team Championship was defended throughout the DDT4 tournament. ¡Peligro Abejas!

zh.s: 2010年Dynamite Duumvirate双打冠军赛（DDT4）是职业摔角联盟PWG举办的第四届该项赛事，于2010年5月9日在美国加利福尼亚州雷塞达的美国军团第308分部举行。PWG世界双打冠军赛在整个锦标赛期间都接受挑战。原文在此处还列有“¡Peligro Abejas!”。

en.s: The 2010 Albanian Cup final was the 58th final of the Albanian Cup. The final was played at the Qemal Stafa Stadium in Tirana on 9 May 2010. The match was contested by Besa, who beat Shkumbini in their semi-final, and Vllaznia who beat Teuta.

zh.s: 2010年阿尔巴尼亚杯决赛是该项赛事第58届决赛，于2010年5月9日在地拉那的凯末尔·斯塔法体育场举行。参赛队伍是贝萨和弗拉兹尼亚：贝萨在半决赛中击败什昆宾，弗拉兹尼亚则击败特乌塔。

en.s: The 2009–10 FA Vase final was the 36th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9-11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Whitley Bay, of the Northern League Division 1 (level 9), and Wroxham, of the Eastern Counties League (level 9). Whitley Bay beat Wroxham 6–1.

zh.s: 2009—10赛季英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是该项赛事第36届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛第九至第十一级。决赛由北部联赛甲级球队惠特利湾对阵东部郡联赛球队沃克瑟姆，两队都处于第九级别。惠特利湾以6比1获胜。

en.s: The 2012 UEFA Europa League Final was the final match of the 2011–12 UEFA Europa League, the 41st season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA (after the UEFA Champions League), and the 3rd season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. The match was played on 9 May 2012 at the Arena Națională in Bucharest, Romania, and was contested between two Spanish sides – Atlético Madrid and Athletic Bilbao.

zh.s: 2012年欧洲联赛决赛是2011—12赛季欧洲联赛的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲第二级别俱乐部赛事的第41届决赛、赛事更名为欧洲联赛后的第3届决赛。比赛于2012年5月9日在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特的国家竞技场举行，由两支西班牙球队马德里竞技和毕尔巴鄂竞技交锋。

en.s: Rebelión de los Juniors (2013) (Spanish for "The Junior Rebellion") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), that took place on May 9, 2013 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event of the show was a 10-man elimination match featuring 10 "Juniors" with the last surviving participant becoming the number one contender for the IWRG Junior de Juniors Championship held by Oficial Factor at the time. The ten competitors were Trauma I, Hijo de Máscara Año 2000, Apolo Estrada, Jr., Freyser, Cien Caras, Jr., El Hijo de Dr.

zh.s: 《Rebelión de los Juniors》（西班牙语意为“少年组叛乱”）是墨西哥职业摔角推广组织国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）每年举办的大型职业摔角赛事，于 2013 年 5 月 9 日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的纳乌卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是一场十人淘汰赛，十名“少年组”选手参赛，最后留在场上的选手将成为当时由 Oficial Factor 持有的 IWRG 少年组冠军赛冠军头号挑战者。十名参赛者是 Trauma I、Hijo de Máscara Año 2000、Apolo Estrada Jr.、Freyser、Cien Caras Jr.、El Hijo de Dr. Wagner、Super Nova、Carta Brava Jr.、El Hijo del Pirata Morgan 和 Trauma II。整场演出另有四场比赛。

en.t: 2013 Social Christian Unity Party presidential primary
en.s: The 2013 presidential primary of the Social Christian Unity Party of Costa Rica was held on May 9, 2013, as part of the 2014 Costa Rican general election. The two main traditional factions of PUSC (Calderonistas and Liberals) competed for the nomination. The competing parties were Costa Rica's Children's Hospital Dr. Rodolfo Hernández, and the lawyer, businessman, and former president of the Costa Rican Social Security Fund Rodolfo Piza.

zh.t: 2013年哥斯达黎加社会基督教团结党党内总统初选
zh.s: 2013年5月9日，哥斯达黎加社会基督教团结党举行总统候选人初选，是2014年哥斯达黎加大选的一部分。该党两个主要派系——卡尔德隆派和自由派——争夺提名。候选人是儿童医院的医生罗多尔福·埃尔南德斯，以及律师、商人、哥斯达黎加社会保障基金前主席罗多尔福·皮萨。

en.s: The 2013 KNVB Cup final was a football match between AZ and PSV Eindhoven that took place on 9 May 2013 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2012–13 KNVB Cup competition and the 95th Dutch Cup Final. AZ won the match 2–1 to defeat the defending champions from the previous season to earn their 4th KNVB Cup trophy.

zh.s: 2013年荷兰杯决赛于2013年5月9日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由阿尔克马尔对阵埃因霍温。这是2012—13赛季荷兰杯的决赛，也是该赛事第95届决赛。阿尔克马尔以2比1获胜，击败卫冕冠军，第四次捧起荷兰杯。

en.s: The 2013 Belgian Cup final, named Cofidis Cup after the sponsor, took place on 9 May 2013 between Genk and Cercle Brugge. It was the 58th Belgian Cup final and was won by Genk, with two late goals by Bennard Yao Kumordzi and Jelle Vossen.

zh.s: 2013年比利时杯决赛因赞助冠名称为Cofidis杯，于2013年5月9日举行，由亨克对阵色格拉布鲁日。这是第58届比利时杯决赛，亨克凭借贝纳德·姚·库莫尔齐和耶勒·沃森在比赛末段的两粒进球获胜。

en.s: The 2013 Danish Cup final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2012–13 Danish Cup. It was played on 9 May 2013 at 15:00 CEST.

zh.s: 2013年丹麦杯决赛决出了2012—13赛季丹麦杯冠军。比赛于2013年5月9日欧洲中部夏令时间15时举行。

en.s: The Guang Da Xing No. 28 incident was a fatal shooting incident that occurred on 9 May 2013 involving the 15-ton Taiwanese fishing boat Guang Da Xing No. 28 and the 90-ton Philippine Coast Guard patrol boat Maritime Control Surveillance 3001, resulting in the death of a 65-year old Taiwanese fisherman Hung Shih-cheng (洪石成) by gunfire from the Philippine vessel.

zh.s: 2013年5月9日，台湾渔船“光大兴28号”与菲律宾海岸警卫队90吨级巡逻艇“海事监控3001号”发生致命枪击事件。65岁的台湾渔民洪石成遭菲律宾船只开枪击中身亡。

en.s: The 2015 Dallas municipal election was an election to determine the mayor in Dallas, Texas. The election day was May 9, 2015, and if a runoff election had been required, it would have been held on June 13, 2015. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Mike Rawlings ran and won re-election to a second term in office against challengers Marcos Ronquillo, an attorney, and write-in candidate Richard Sheridan, a retired engineer and anti-gay government activist.

zh.s: 2015年5月9日，得克萨斯州达拉斯举行市政选举，选出市长。如有需要，将于6月13日举行第二轮投票。时任民主党市长迈克·罗林斯击败律师马科斯·龙基约和退休工程师、反同性恋政策活动人士理查德·谢里丹，连任第二届。

en.s: The 2015 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 9, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and is officially nonpartisan. The mayoral term in Fort Worth is two years. Incumbent Mayor Betsy Price, a Republican who was first elected in 2011, ran unopposed for a third term.

zh.s: 2015年5月9日，得克萨斯州沃思堡举行市长选举，与其他地方选举同时进行。选举不分党派，市长任期为两年。共和党籍时任市长贝齐·普赖斯于2011年首次当选，本次无人挑战，顺利开始第三个任期。

en.t: 2015 Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario leadership election
en.s: The 2015 Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario leadership election was held on May 9, 2015, as a result of the resignation of Ontario Progressive Conservative leader Tim Hudak following the provincial election on June 12, 2014, his second loss in a row as party leader. Patrick Brown won the leadership with 61.8% of votes allocated, defeating Christine Elliott who had 38.2%.

zh.t: 2015年安大略省进步保守党党魁选举
zh.s: 2015年5月9日，安大略省进步保守党举行党魁选举。时任党魁蒂姆·胡达克在2014年6月12日省选举中连续第二次失利后辞职，触发本次选举。帕特里克·布朗以61.8%的分配票数当选，击败获得38.2%的克里斯汀·艾略特。

en.s: On May 9, 2015, the city of San Antonio, Texas, held an election to choose the next Mayor of San Antonio. Interim mayor Ivy Taylor ran for election to a full term and narrowly defeated former state senator Leticia Van de Putte in the runoff election on June 13, 2015, to become the first African American elected to the position. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 2015年5月9日，得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥举行市长选举。代理市长艾维·泰勒竞选完整任期，并在6月13日的第二轮投票中以微弱优势击败前州参议员莱蒂西亚·范德普特，成为首位经选举担任该职位的非裔美国人。选举不分党派。

en.s: The 2014–15 FA Vase final was the 41st final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9-11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between North Shields, of the Northern League Division 1 (level 9), and Glossop North End, of the North West Counties League Premier Division (level 9). North Shields won the final 2-1 after extra time.

zh.s: 2014—15赛季英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是该项赛事第41届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛第九至第十一级。参赛双方是北部联赛甲级球队北希尔兹和西北郡联赛超级组球队格洛索普北区，两队都处于第九级别。北希尔兹在加时赛后以2比1获胜。

en.s: The Philippine presidential and vice presidential elections of 2016 was held on Monday, May 9, 2016, as part of the 2016 general election. This was the 16th presidential election in the Philippines since 1935 and the sixth sextennial presidential election since 1986. Incumbent President Benigno Aquino III was barred from seeking re-election, pursuant to the 1987 Philippine Constitution. Therefore, this election determined the 16th President of the Philippines. The position of president and vice president were elected separately, thus the two winning candidates could come from different political parties. Rodrigo Duterte led the preliminary count with 38.5% of the vote, a lead thought to be unassailable.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日（星期一），菲律宾举行总统和副总统选举，是当年大选的一部分。这是1935年以来菲律宾第16次总统选举，也是1986年以来第六次每六年举行一次的总统选举。根据1987年菲律宾宪法，时任总统贝尼尼奥·阿基诺三世不得寻求连任，因此本次选举将选出菲律宾第16任总统。总统和副总统分别选出，因此两名胜选者可能来自不同政党。初步计票中，罗德里戈·杜特尔特以38.5%的选票领先，当时认为这个领先优势难以逆转。

en.t: Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao general election, 2016
en.s: The 2016 general election in the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) was held on May 9, 2016. This was the second ARMM election that was synchronized with the general elections in the Philippines. The governor and vice governor are elected via first past the post system; they are elected separately and may come from different parties. Elections for the regional assembly are via plurality-at-large voting, with each assembly district (coextensive with legislative districts as used in House of Representatives elections) having three seats. A voter can vote for up to the three candidates, with the candidates with the three highest total number of votes being elected.

zh.t: 2016年棉兰老穆斯林自治区大选
zh.s: 2016年5月9日，棉兰老穆斯林自治区（ARMM）举行大选，与菲律宾全国大选同时进行。这是该自治区第二次与全国大选同步举行选举。自治区长和副自治区长分别以简单多数制选出，两人可能来自不同政党。自治区议会选举采用全体候选人简单多数制，每个议会选区（与众议院选区范围一致）选出三人。选民最多可投三名候选人，得票最高的三人当选。

en.s: Local elections in Navotas were held on May 9, 2016, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the mayor, vice mayor, one congressman, and the councilors – six in each of the city's two districts.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，纳沃塔斯举行地方选举，是菲律宾大选的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长、一名国会议员和市议员；市内两个选区各选出六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Manila on May 9, 2016, as a part of the 2016 Philippine general election. Voters elected candidates for mayor, vice mayor, six congressmen, and the 36 councilors that would be members of the city council. Incumbent mayor Joseph Estrada won the elections, securing him to serve his second three-year term as the mayor of Manila.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，马尼拉举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长、六名国会议员和36名市议员，后者组成市议会。时任市长约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达胜选，开始第二个三年市长任期。

en.s: The 2016 election of members to the Senate of the Philippines was the 32nd election of members to the Senate of the Philippines. It was held on Monday, May 9, 2016, The seats of 12 senators elected in 2010 were filled during this election. The winners in this election joined the winners of the 2013 election to form the 17th Congress of the Philippines.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日（星期一），菲律宾举行第32次参议院选举，选出12名参议员，接替2010年当选的参议员。新当选者与2013年当选的参议员组成第17届国会。

en.s: Local elections were held in Las Piñas on May 9, 2016, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the one Congressman, and the councilors, six in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，拉斯皮尼亚斯举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长、一名国会议员，以及市内两个国会选区各六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections in the Philippines were held on May 9, 2016. This was conducted together with the 2016 general election for national positions. All elected positions above the barangay (village) level were disputed.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾举行地方选举，与全国大选同时进行。村级以上的所有民选职位均进行改选。

en.s: Local elections were held in Cabuyao on May 9, 2016, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, and ten councilors.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，卡布尧举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长和10名市议员。

en.s: Local elections was held in Lipa City on May 9, 2016 within the Philippine general election. The voters will elect candidates for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the congressman (which will represent Batangas' sixth district which is composed of just the city), two provincial board members, and the 12 members of its city council.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，利帕市举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长、代表巴丹加斯省第六选区的一名国会议员、两名省议员和12名市议员。该国会选区仅包括利帕市。

en.s: Local elections were held in Antipolo on May 9, 2016, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected candidates for the local elective posts in the city: the mayor, the vice mayor, the two district representatives, the two provincial board members (one for each district) and the sixteen councilors (eight for each district).

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，安蒂波洛举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长、两名选区代表、两名省议员（每个选区一名）和16名市议员（每个选区八名）。

en.s: Local elections were held in Pasay on May 9, 2016, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the congressman, and the councilors, six of them in the two districts of the city.

zh.s: 2016年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，帕赛举行地方选举。选民选出市长、副市长、一名国会议员和市议员；两个选区各选出六名市议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Batangas on May 9, 2016, as part of the 2016 general election. en.s: The 2018 Sabah state election took place on 9 May 2018 in concurrence with the 14th Malaysian general election. This election was to elect 60 members of the 15th Sabah State Legislative Assembly. The previous Assembly was dissolved on 7 April 2018. Barisan Nasional (BN), with the most seats, would be able to form a minority government alone.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，沙巴州举行选举，与马来西亚第14届大选同日进行，选出第15届沙巴州议会60名议员。上一届州议会于2018年4月7日解散。国民阵线赢得最多席位，可以单独组建少数派政府。

en.s: State elections were held in all states and territories in Malaysia except Sarawak on 9 May 2018, alongside general elections. Pakatan Harapan alliance received over 50% of the vote across the 12 states and territories where elections took place and won the most seats. They emerged as the largest faction in all states and territories except Kelantan, Terengganu, Perlis and Pahang.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，除砂拉越外，马来西亚所有州和联邦直辖区都举行州级选举，与全国大选同时进行。希望联盟在举行选举的12个州和联邦直辖区合计获得超过半数选票和最多席位，并在除吉兰丹、登嘉楼、玻璃市和彭亨以外的各州及直辖区成为最大政治阵营。

en.s: The 2018 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match played on May 9, 2018, in Dnipro between Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv. The culmination of the 2017–18 Ukrainian Cup season, this was the second time the cup final had been held in Dnipro. The match was the 27th Ukrainian Cup Final since the fall of the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，顿涅茨克矿工和基辅迪纳摩在第聂伯罗进行乌克兰杯决赛。这是2017—18赛季的收官战，也是苏联解体后举行的第27届乌克兰杯决赛。

en.s: The 14th Johor State election was held on 9 May 2018, concurrently with the 2018 Malaysian general election. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，柔佛州举行第14届州选举，与马来西亚大选同日举行。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。每名州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 14th Terengganu State election was held on 9 May 2018, concurrently with the 2018 Malaysian general election. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，登嘉楼州举行第14届州选举，与马来西亚大选同日举行。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。每名州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 2018 Austrian Cup final was played on 9 May 2018 between SK Sturm Graz and FC Red Bull Salzburg at Wörthersee Stadion, Klagenfurt, a neutral ground. The final was the culmination of the 2017–18 Austrian Cup, the 84th season of the Austrian Cup.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，格拉茨风暴和萨尔茨堡红牛在克拉根福的沃尔特湖球场进行奥地利杯决赛，比赛场地为中立场。这场比赛决出了2017—18赛季奥地利杯冠军，是该赛事第84个赛季的收官战。

en.s: The 14th Penang election was held on 9 May 2018 to elect the State Assemblymen of the 14th Penang State Legislative Assembly, the legislature of the Malaysian state of Penang. The legislature had been dissolved on 9 April by the state's Governor, Abdul Rahman Abbas, on the advice of the then Chief Minister Lim Guan Eng, who also led the state's ruling Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalition.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，槟城州举行第14届州选举，选出第14届槟城州议会的议员。槟城州议会于4月9日解散，州元首阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿巴斯应时任首席部长、希望联盟领袖林冠英的建议作出这一决定。

en.s: The 14th Selangor state election was held on 9 May 2018 to elect the State Assemblymen of the 14th Selangor State Legislative Assembly, the legislature of the Malaysian state of Selangor. The Selangor State Legislative Assembly was dissolved in a simple ceremony on 9 April 2018 by Sharafuddin of Selangor.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，雪兰莪州举行第14届州选举，选出第14届雪兰莪州议会议员。雪兰莪州议会于2018年4月9日在一场简短仪式上解散，由雪兰莪苏丹沙拉弗丁主持。

en.s: The 14th Perak State election was held on 9 May 2018. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. Each of the state assemblymen are elected to a five-year term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，霹雳州举行第14届州选举。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。每名州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 14th Pahang State election was held on 9 May 2018, concurrently with the 2018 Malaysian general election. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，彭亨州举行第14届州选举，与马来西亚大选同日举行。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。每名州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 14th Malacca election was held on 9 May 2018 to elect the State Assemblymen of the 14th Malacca State Legislative Assembly, the legislature of the Malaysian state of Malacca. The Malacca State Legislative Assembly dissolved on 7 April 2018 by the Head of State (Yang di-Pertua Negeri of Malacca) on the advice of the Head of Government (Chief Minister of Malacca).

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，马六甲州举行第14届州选举，选出第14届马六甲州议会的议员。马六甲州议会于2018年4月7日解散，由州元首应政府首脑、马六甲首席部长的建议作出决定。

en.s: The 2018 Coppa Italia final decided the winner of the 2017–18 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 9 May 2018 at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome between rivals Juventus and Milan. Juventus won the match 4–0 with all four goals coming in the second half, winning their fourth consecutive Coppa Italia title and 13th title overall.

zh.s: 2018年意大利杯决赛决出了2017—18赛季意大利杯冠军，是意大利主要足球杯赛的决赛。比赛于2018年5月9日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由老对手尤文图斯和AC米兰对阵。尤文图斯以4比0获胜，四个进球都在下半场打入。这是尤文图斯连续第四次、总计第13次夺得意大利杯。

en.s: The 14th Kelantan State election was held on 9 May 2018, concurrently with the 2018 Malaysian general election. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，吉兰丹州举行第14届州选举，与马来西亚大选同日举行。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。每名州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 2018 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2017–18 Russian Cup, the 26th season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 9 May 2018 at the Volgograd Arena, between Tosno and Avangard Kursk. Tosno won the game courtesy of goals from Aleksei Skvortsov and Reziuan Mirzov, with Igor Kireyev scoring a consolation goal for the second division side.

zh.s: 2018年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2017—18赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，也是俄罗斯主要足球杯赛的第26个赛季。比赛于2018年5月9日在伏尔加格勒竞技场举行，由托斯诺对阵库尔斯克先锋。托斯诺凭阿列克谢·斯科尔佐夫和雷兹万·米尔佐夫的进球获胜，库尔斯克先锋由伊戈尔·基列耶夫打入一球。

en.s: The 14th Negeri Sembilan State election was held on 9 May 2018, to elect the State Assemblymen of the Negeri Sembilan State Legislative Assembly, the legislature of the Malaysian state of Negeri Sembilan. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，森美兰州举行第14届州选举，选出州议会议员。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The 14th Kedah State election was held on 9 May 2018, concurrently with the 2018 Malaysian general election. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

en.s: The 2018 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2017–18 Bulgarian Cup and the 78th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final took place on 9 May 2018 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. It was refereed by Nikola Popov. The clubs contesting the final were Slavia Sofia and Levski Sofia. The match finished in a 0–0 draw, but Slavia clinched their eighth Bulgarian Cup title by winning 4–2 on penalties.

zh.s: 2018年保加利亚杯决赛是2017—18赛季的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事第78届决赛。比赛于2018年5月9日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，由索非亚斯拉维亚对阵索非亚列夫斯基，尼古拉·波波夫担任裁判。双方0比0战平后，斯拉维亚在点球大战中以4比2获胜，拿下队史第八个保加利亚杯冠军。

en.s: The 14th Perlis State election was held on 9 May 2018. The previous state election was held on 5 May 2013. The state assemblymen is elected to 5 years term each.

zh.s: 2018年5月9日，玻璃市州举行第14届州选举。上一次州选举于2013年5月5日举行。州议会议员任期五年。

en.s: The PFL 1 mixed martial arts event for the 2019 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on May 9, 2019, at the Nassau Coliseum in Uniondale, New York. This was the first regular season event of the tournament and included fights in the welterweight and women's lightweight divisions.

zh.t: 职业格斗联盟2019赛季首场赛事
zh.s: 职业格斗联盟2019赛季首场综合格斗赛事于2019年5月9日在美国纽约州尤宁代尔的拿骚体育馆举行。作为本赛季常规赛首场比赛，赛事安排了次中量级和女子轻量级对阵。

en.s: UFC 249: Ferguson vs. Gaethje was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 9, 2020 at VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena in Jacksonville, Florida, United States. It was originally planned to take place on April 18 at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York, United States. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was eventually postponed (see section below).

zh.s: UFC 249：弗格森对盖奇是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年5月9日在美国佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔的VyStar退伍军人纪念体育馆举行。赛事原定于4月18日在纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心举行，后因新冠疫情延期。

en.s: The Northern Chad offensive was a military offensive in Northern Chad, initiated by the Chadian rebel group Front for Change and Concord in Chad (FACT), took place from 11 April to 9 May 2021. It began in the Tibesti Region in the north of the country following the 2021 Chadian presidential election.

en.s: Presidential elections in the Philippines were held on May 9, 2022, as part of the 2022 general election. This was the 17th direct presidential election and 15th vice presidential election in the country since 1935, and the sixth sextennial presidential and vice presidential election since 1992. Incumbent president Rodrigo Duterte was ineligible for re-election because the president is limited to a single term under the 1987 Philippine Constitution.

zh.s: 2022年5月9日，菲律宾举行总统选举，是当年大选的一部分。这是菲律宾自1935年以来第17次直接总统选举和第15次副总统选举，也是1992年以来第六次每六年举行一次的总统和副总统选举。根据1987年菲律宾宪法，总统只能连任一届，因此时任总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特不能再次参选。

en.s: Local elections in the Philippines took place on May 9, 2022. These were conducted together with the 2022 general election for national positions. All elected positions above the barangay (village) level but below the regional level were disputed.

zh.s: 2022年5月9日，菲律宾举行地方选举，与全国职位的大选同时进行。村级以上、地区级以下的所有民选职位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2022 Philippine general election took place on May 9, 2022, for the executive and legislative branches of government at every level – national, provincial, and local – except for the barangay officials. At the top of the ballot is the election for the successors to President Rodrigo Duterte and Vice President Leni Robredo.

zh.s: 2022年5月9日，菲律宾举行大选，选出各级政府行政和立法机构成员，包括全国、省级和地方职位，村级官员除外。选票上的主要职位是选出接替总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特和副总统莱妮·罗布雷多的人选。

en.s: Local elections were held in Cebu City on May 9, 2022 within the Philippine general election. Registered voters of the city elected their mayor, vice mayor, district representatives, and city council members. The mayor and vice mayor were elected in separate first-past-the-post votes. While for the legislative branch, Cebu City is divided into two districts wherein the constituents of each district elected a congressional representative (through first-past-the-post voting) and eight regular city council members (through multi-member plurality voting).

zh.s: 2022年5月9日，菲律宾大选期间，宿务市举行地方选举。登记选民选出市长、副市长、选区代表和市议员。市长和副市长分别以简单多数制选出。宿务市分为两个选区，每个选区选出一名国会议员和八名市议员；国会议员采用简单多数制，市议员则采用多席位选举制。

en.t: 2022 Philippine vice presidential election results in Ilocos Norte
en.s: In the 2022 Philippine vice-presidential election, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte won decisively in Ilocos Norte, receiving 342,554 votes, or 93.80% of the total. Senate President Vicente "Tito" Sotto III came in second with 10,303 votes (2.82%), while Senator Francis "Kiko" Pangilinan followed with 7,973 votes, amounting to 2.18%.This result reflects the strong backing for Duterte in the province, which is also the political stronghold of her running mate, Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr.

zh.t: 2022年菲律宾副总统选举北伊罗戈省投票结果

en.t: 2022 Philippine presidential election in Eastern Samar
en.s: In the 2022 Philippine presidential election in Eastern Samar, ten candidates were present. The eventual winner was Leni Robredo locally, with Bongbong Marcos in 2nd place, and Manny Pacquiao in third place. On February 8, the first campaign started in Eastern Samar, when Leni Robredo started a caravan with thousands of people. The next month, 19 mayors, the governor himself, and the congresswoman expressed their support for Leni Robredo after the Kakampink rally in Baybay Boulevard.

en.t: 2022 Philippine presidential election in Ilocos Norte
en.s: Ilocos Norte, known as the bailiwick of former Senator Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr., overwhelmingly supported his presidential bid in the 2022 Philippine election. Marcos, who previously served as the province's governor from 1998 to 2007, secured 356,221 votes, translating to 95.84%—the highest vote percentage of any presidential candidate in all provinces. His closest rival, Vice President Maria Leonor "Leni" Robredo, garnered only 10,043 votes, representing a mere 2.70%.

en.s: In the 2022 Philippine presidential election, former Senator Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. narrowly won the province of Batangas, defeating Vice President Maria Leonor "Leni" Robredo by a close margin of 4.11%. en.t: Russo-Ukrainian war: United States President Joe Biden signs the 2022 Lend-Lease Act into law, a rebooted World War II-era policy attempting to expedite American equipment to Ukraine and other Eastern European countries
en.s: The Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act of 2022 was an act of the United States Congress that facilitated the supply of materiel to the Ukrainian government in a manner similar to the World War II Lend-Lease Act in response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act expired in September 2023, without being used.
